entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: A gigantic lush forest region in South Aerona on Dominaria, home to the Llanowar elves and seven elfhames.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Llanowar lies.

entities.name: Llanowar elves
entities.description: Reclusive, fierce elves of the Llanowar forest who divide themselves into seven elfhames.

entities.name: Order of the Steel Leaf
entities.description: A select, zealously isolationist cadre of Llanowar elves said to have been brought together by Freyalise.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A beautiful half-elven planeswalker considered a goddess by the elves of Llanowar, who are unaware of her heritage.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: The leader around whose banner all Llanowar rallied during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior trained in magic together with Gerrard who lived for a while in Llanowar.

entities.name: Gerrard
entities.description: Trained in magic together with Mirri.

entities.name: Rofellos
entities.description: A person Mirri met in Llanowar.

entities.name: Molimo, Maro-Sorcerer
entities.description: Resident of the ancient tree Pendelhaven.

entities.name: Pendelhaven
entities.description: An immense, ancient tree believed to predate much of Dominaria.

entities.name: The Dreaming Caves
entities.description: A cavern refuge during the Phyrexian Invasion where nightmares came alive until Eladamri calmed them.

entities.name: Kelfae
entities.description: An elfhame where elves raise kavu.

entities.name: Riashil
entities.description: A peacekeeping elfhame devoted to harmony.

entities.name: Ruadach
entities.description: The most human-friendly elfhame, with capital Scoria.

entities.name: Staprion
entities.description: A militant elfhame famed for its fierce warriors.

entities.name: The Necromantic Morass
entities.description: A swampy region of Llanowar warped by necromancy.

entities.name: Abomination of Llanowar
entities.description: An undead monstrosity formed when a scout troop of elves was fused together by the necromantic morass.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian attack on Dominaria, which Llanowar defended against under Eladamri.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event after which Llanowar was one of the first regions to be rejuvenated.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders of Dominaria who were repelled from Llanowar.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: A nation northwest of Llanowar; in the Echoverse it attacked Llanowar.

events.summary: A Llanowar scout troop discovers the necromantic morass; a curious recruit touches it and it fuses the elves into an undead monstrosity.
events.quote: A curious recruit touched the dark tangle, and it imploded, sucking the elves in and fusing them into an undead monstrosity.

events.summary: A second scout troop is pulled alive into the monstrosity; one elf escapes and that part of the forest is declared forbidden.
events.quote: A single elf escaped, and that part of the forest was declared forbidden.

events.summary: With Freyalise's help the Llanowar elves keep their culture intact through the Ice Age and Thaw, and the Steel Leaf takes isolationism to the extreme.
events.quote: With the help of Freyalise the elves of Llanowar managed to keep their cultures intact throughout even the most difficult of times.

events.summary: Mirri lives for a while in Llanowar, where she meets Rofellos.
events.quote: This is where she met Rofellos .

events.summary: During the Phyrexian Invasion all Llanowar rallies around Eladamri and successfully defends the forest from the Phyrexians.
events.quote: During the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria , all Llanowar rallied around Eladamri 's banner and united in his name, successfully defending the forest from the Phyrexians .

events.summary: After the Mending Llanowar is among the first regions to be rejuvenated.
events.quote: Llanowar was one of the first Dominarian regions that were rejuvenated after the Mending .

events.summary: In the Echoverse, Benalia attacks Llanowar during the second Brothers' War, forcing the elves to mechanize and cut down the forest.
events.quote: Benalia attacked Llanowar while expanding their borders.

relations.note: A forest region in South Aerona on Dominaria.
relations.quote: Llanowar ( /lanoʊwɔːr/, LAN-oh-wahr ) is a gigantic lush forest region in South Aerona , southeast of Benalia on Dominaria .
